package lesson

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

func normalizeLessonVersions(entries []domain.LessonVersion) []domain.LessonVersion {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.LessonVersion, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.TechVersionID <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[entry.TechVersionID]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[entry.TechVersionID] = struct{}{}
		if entry.Status != domain.LessonVersionStatusNoActive && entry.Status != domain.LessonVersionStatusActive {
			entry.Status = domain.LessonVersionStatusActive
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result
}

func normalizeTranslations(entries []domain.LessonI18n) []domain.LessonI18n {
	seen := make(map[int]struct{})
	result := make([]domain.LessonI18n, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.I18nID <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		title := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Title)
		excerpt := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Excerpt)
		description := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Description)
		if title == "" || excerpt == "" || description == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[entry.I18nID]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[entry.I18nID] = struct{}{}
		entry.Title = title
		entry.Excerpt = excerpt
		entry.Description = description
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	return result
}

func resolveCreateLessonStatus(status *int) int {
	if status == nil {
		return domain.LessonStatusNoActive
	}
	if *status == domain.LessonStatusNoActive || *status == domain.LessonStatusActive {
		return *status
	}
	return domain.LessonStatusNoActive
}

func countActiveLessonTasks(ctx context.Context, tasks repository.TaskRepository, lessonID string) (int, error) {
	if tasks == nil {
		return 0, nil
	}
	list, err := tasks.ListByLesson(ctx, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	activeCount := 0
	for _, item := range list {
		if item.Status == domain.TaskStatusActive {
			activeCount++
		}
	}
	return activeCount, nil
}

func ensureLessonCanBeActive(ctx context.Context, tasks repository.TaskRepository, lessonID string) error {
	activeCount, err := countActiveLessonTasks(ctx, tasks, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if activeCount > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: active lesson requires at least one active task", domain.ErrValidation)
}

func ensureLessonCanBeDeactivated(ctx context.Context, courses repository.CourseRepository, courseID string) error {
	if courses == nil || strings.TrimSpace(courseID) == "" {
		return nil
	}
	course, err := courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if course.Status == domain.CourseStatusActive {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: cannot deactivate lesson while parent course is active", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return nil
}
